messages:
samir: Quick check — can we get 6x H100 slots in apac-staging for a canary run next Wed (2026-03-25 14:00 UTC)? Need 4 long (≈8h) + 2 short (≈2h). Need vendor confirmation + an infra carve.

elena: cc @vendor-liaison — we need to lock this by EOD tomorrow if possible. Cost center ENG-STAGING-2.

harry: We only have 2 standby H100s in apac right now. I pinged the vendor at 09:12; waiting on availability and invoice.

vendor-liaison: Vendor update: can provision but requires swapping 4 standby A100 -> H100 racks in that zone. They need PO confirmation and a 4hr lead time after PO. ETA for final yes/no: today 18:00 UTC.

jia: FYI terraform PR is here: https://git.internal/repo/infra/pulls/3724 — it adds a reservation for apac-staging-h100 (6 slots). Blocker: billing account needs to be attached to ENG-STAGING-2.

samir: thanks. @jia can you rebase + add a `depends_on` so reservation doesn't race with subnet creation?

jia: yup, adding depends_on in a sec. snippet: ```resource "google_compute_reservation" "apac-h100" {  name = "apac-staging-h100"  specific_reservation = {    count = 6    accelerator_type = "nvidia-h100"  }}```

sre-oncall: I ran a quick quota check: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=apac-staging` shows GPU quota 10 total, H100 quota currently 6 used 0 available. Seems we have headroom but reservations require billing/PO to be attached.

terraform-bot: Automated check: PR 3724 terraform plan passed (no diffs that affect prod). Plan output: `+ google_compute_reservation.apac-h100 (will be created)`

elena: If vendor confirms, I can sign PO today. Who owns the invoice approval? @harry?

harry: I can approve invoice up to $X. Need exact cost from vendor — asked them to DM pricing breakdown.

vendor-liaison: Pricing DM'ed to @harry. Quick note: if we want the 4 long slots guaranteed, vendor recommends a 24h soft-hold; otherwise risk of a last-minute swap.

samir: fallback plan if vendor can't confirm — can we run a reduced canary in eu-west1 (latency will be worse but functional)? Or use quantized L40s in apac as a shorter-term option?

harry: eu-west1 has 6 available H100 spare but would need cross-region routing test. L40 quantized is an option for perf-only tests, not for the full KV-cache canary.

elena: decision: wait for vendor confirmation at 18:00 UTC. If yes -> PO + merge PR 3724 -> schedule reservation for Wed 14:00 UTC. If no -> run reduced eu-west1 canary and retry apac carve next window.

samir: sounds good. I'll post a short runbook for the canary steps once PR is merged.

jia: taking action: rebased + added depends_on, updated PR description with cost center and run times.

vendor-liaison: Confirmed vendor acceptance at 17:42 UTC — they can soft-hold 6 H100s for 24h pending PO. Please send PO before 19:30 UTC to meet lead time.

elena: PO sent at 18:05 UTC, attaching invoice number INV-2026-0912.

harry: approved invoice at 18:12 UTC. @terraform-bot can you re-run plan/apply?

terraform-bot: Triggering apply: `terraform apply -auto-approve` — started at 18:16 UTC. Apply completed at 18:23 UTC. Reservation apac-staging-h100 created.

sre-oncall: Verified reservation: `gcloud compute reservations describe apac-staging-h100 --project=apac-staging` -> status: RESERVED, count: 6.

samir: awesome, thanks all :thumbsup: I'll draft the canary runbook and ping next steps in this thread.

elena: lovely, please include a smoke-test checklist and rollback steps.

samir: will do — follow-up expected by EOD today.
